title: Synthetic dataset card (p1-evaluation-s01)
description: Every synthetic dataset has a card, so nobody can later mistake it for real data. `publish.py` refuses an incomplete card, a card whose generator or files do not exist, and a file whose row count differs from the card.

seed.description: how the seed is fixed (a number, or 'derived from the case id')

source.description: what it is made from: authored cases, a simulation, a model

validation.description: how it was checked and what the check does not show

review.description: who looked at it; an honest 'not reviewed by a person' is allowed

labels.description: what labels it carries and who gave them

model_use.description: which model, test or tool reads it, or 'none'

rows.description: file -> JSON pointer-like path of the list whose length is the row count -> expected count
